## Release 2.8.0 (Sep 19 09:45 +02 / 07:45 UTC Sat Sep 19): **TRADING ANALYTICS & REVIEW — new dashboard section + A4 reports (deployed, Joachim-requested feature)** - release 2.8.0 (bundle md5 **2664cfec8bf746829f14d3f5d0f6eec5**, 357,050 B, RELEASE_VERSION 2.8.0), 261 tests / 956 assertions PASS (18 new analytics tests), typecheck 0. **New:** (1) `src/analytics.ts` — deterministic Trading-Analytics engine computing per-closed-trade analysis from stored D1 data only: Decision Quality scored from ENTRY-TIME information exclusively (TA snapshot emaTrend/macdTrend/adx/volumeRatio/rsi/pricePosition/vwapDeviation + confidence + planned R:R from intent stop/target; realized outcome NEVER enters the score — no hindsight/outcome bias; labels Strong/Good/Questionable/Weak + internal 0-100 score), Execution Quality (slippage = |fill - price_at_decision| vs ATR tolerance), Trade Management (planned-envelope adherence proxy), Exit Quality (close_reason semantics), Outcome (P/L, P/L %, realized R from stored stop × qty, initial risk in USD), acceptable-vs-avoidable loss classification (Strong/Good + compliant + slippage-within-ATR = acceptable), whatWorked/whatCouldImprove/learningPoint generated from concrete findings only, MFE/MAE/funding/leverage explicitly null ("Insufficient data" in UI) because the broker integration does not record them — NOTHING fabricated. (2) `GET /api/analytics` — strictly read-only, period (7/30/90/YTD/all/custom), filters (strategy, symbol, side, result, regime, confidence band); returns KPIs (net P/L, win rate, profit factor, expectancy + expectancy-in-R, avg win/loss, avg planned R:R, max drawdown, avg duration, attributed fees, long/short split, avg decision quality, avg realized R), cumulative P/L + drawdown curves, confidence calibration (5 bands) with explicit miscalibration verdict, combination pattern analysis (side × regime × volatility × confidence-band, n>=3, evidence Preliminary/Moderate/Strong by sample size, chronological 60/40 out-of-sample check), winner/loser top/bottom 20%, day-vs-swing comparison across risk/consistency/expectancy/drawdown/costs/duration/result-volatility (no simplistic "best" verdict), research backlog (Title/Observation/Evidence/Sample size/Hypothesis/Proposed test/Success criteria/Status=New — hypotheses to backtest, never direct strategy changes), robustness block with chronological split. (3) Dashboard "Analytics" tab — same design tokens/components, period buttons + custom dates, filters, KPI grid, cumulative P/L + drawdown charts, calibration table, patterns (What Works / Needs Attention), day-vs-swing comparison, research backlog, trade-by-trade analysis with per-trade detail (market context, ORIGINAL AI thesis unchanged, entry/execution/management/exit review, outcome, data gaps). (4) A4 reports — Export Day/Swing Trading Report buttons build a one-page A4 portrait sheet (header, 6-8 KPIs, cumulative P/L main graph, max 3 What Works + 3 Improvements, 3-5 line Trading Review; priority-ordered content so it can NEVER exceed one page; black/white-safe with symbols not color-only) and open the print dialog for Save-as-PDF. (5) `analytics_snapshots` D1 table + daily watermark-gated snapshot write in scheduled maintenance (`last_analytics_snapshot_date` config, ONCE/day, idempotent upsert) so improvement over time is measurable; table also created idempotently by the writer (analytics-snapshots-migration.sql for fresh installs). Original AI thesis (decisions.reason/ai_reasoning) is never rewritten; post-trade review text is a separate field. Caps/guards/min_confidence 0.8 UNTOUCHED by this release.
